text: Landed as 9d2a6d6. Verified 177 graphics tests on JVM and 177 on Scala.js, plus SVG JVM/JS, Canvas JS, Java2D JVM, and JavaFX JVM. The visual-QA workflow generated and was manually inspected against ggplot2: dodge centers and widths and stack bounds match after the intentional one-unit categorical translation; seeded jitter is deterministic on JVM/JS and compared semantically because ScalaFIM owns its RNG.
